column1: # derivation: AVG skips NULLs (§2.1) and divides by the count of non-NULL
# values. §2.12: AVG of integers sums exactly and divides once, in DOUBLE.
# = 2^52 + 1, a double (below 2^53). Summing in DOUBLE would read 2^53 + 1
# 1.0 = 2.0 over 4 = 0.5. g = 3: no non-NULL value, so NULL (§2.2).
# Tolerance: float AVG may vary with summation order (§2.10), so avg_f is
# compared within 1 ulp; avg_i is integer AVG, exact (§2.12). Types: AVG is
# FLOAT64 (§8.5), nullable (§2.2); g keeps its scanned type.
